4. Alternatives Considered:
(a) Non-approval of the Leases:
(b) Lease modification alternatives, including modification of the lease terms and deferred development
(c) Approval subject to the new regulations
(d) Alternative sources of Crow Indian income
(e) Extraction alternatives
(f) Coal transportation alternatives
(g) Reclamation alternatives for different land uses
(h) Entrepreneurship alternatives, both Indian and Non-Indian.
